children: US stock futures fell sharply on Friday as disappointing earnings from major technology companies dampened market sentiment.
Nasdaq 100 futures dropped around 1.6%, while S&P 500 futures declined 0.6%.
In after-hours trading, Amazon shares plunged 7% after missing earnings and revenue estimates, while announcing a sharp increase in capital expenditures to support growing demand for AI services.
Intel also sank 23% after issuing a disappointing forecast for the current quarter, citing signs of weakness in the PC market.
Meanwhile, Sandisk slipped nearly 4% despite reporting better-than-expected earnings and revenue.
During Thursday’s regular session, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell 1.38%, while the Dow and S&P 500 declined 0.25% and 0.3%, respectively.
Alphabet, Google’s parent company, tumbled 12.6% as weaker-than-expected search and advertising sales intensified concerns that AI could threaten its core business.

title: US Futures Drop on Disappointing Tech Earnings
